title: Start a branch from a clean tree
run:
set -euo pipefail
if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain -- . ':!.swarm')" ]; then
  echo "this folder has uncommitted changes; commit or stash them first:" >&2
  git status --short -- . ':!.swarm' >&2
  exit 1
fi
branch="swarm/$(printf %s {{run_id}})"
git switch -c "$branch" >&2
jq -n --arg branch "$branch" --arg base "$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)" '{branch: $branch, base: $base}'
